summary: Iran halted strikes on Israel, crushing VIX -9.1% and WTI -3.23% in a broad de-risking rally across all four indices. Chips staged a comeback (AMKR, ONTO, INTC, TER, KLAC all +5-9%) while ADBE fell -6.76% despite a beat-and-raise on CFO Dan Durn's surprise exit. SpaceX's record $75B IPO debuted +19%, making Musk the world's first trillionaire.
